field_changes.old: No major fixes or big changes to report, just tuning things up to keep the app running smoothly.
field_changes.new:
Fixed: After changing your Total Daily Goal from the Calories By Meal screen, the old goal wouldn’t update. Now your new goal shows up the moment you hit Save.

Fixed: For non-english users, food logged using Quick Add wasn’t showing up in your Diary. The calories counted, but the food vanished. Now your food entries show up where they should.

*Bugs: great for the environment, bad for your logging experience.
*For all the latest fixes, update to the latest app version
